'''Ohwun De Maal''', sometimes known by his aliases '''Ellorrs Madak''' and '''Bringe''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] who, like the typical member of the [[Species/Legends|race]], had natural [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] and [[Navigator/Legends|navigation]] skill. Maal owned a [[DH-17 blaster pistol/Legends|DH-17 blaster pistol]].

==Biography==
[[File:Ellorrs_Madak_blaster.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Ohwun De Maal reaching for his blaster pistol]]
He was a former [[Scout/Legends|scout]] and freelance instructor, teaching whoever would pay him how to fly [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. He made several runs to important trade worlds such as [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]], [[Byblos/Legends|Byblos]], and [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]]. Along with his wife, [[Chachi De Maal/Legends|Chachi De Maal]], the pair owned several [[Hangar/Legends|docking bays]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] including [[Docking Bay 27 (Mos Eisley)|Docking Bays 27]], [[Docking Bay 43|43]], [[Docking Bay 67|67]], [[Docking Bay 71|71]], [[Docking Bay 86|86]], and [[Docking Bay 94/Legends|94]]. They also owned the droid [[WED-9-M1/Legends|WED-9-M1]]. Owhun and his wife were both in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] during [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] fateful encounter with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. During Solo's stay on Tatooine, he happened to be using Docking Bay 94, owned by the pair (and by Ohwun's father before them). When Solo and his group blasted out of the docking bay past the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the previous amicable friendship between the Duros and [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] turned sour.

Ohwun and his wife sometimes worked for the Galactic Empire, and in their line of work, dealing with shady characters on a frequent basis, they used several aliases. Among the ones Ohwun used were ''Ellorrs Madak'' and ''Bringe'', who were never seen without their respective partners, ''Baniss Keeg'' and ''Probos'', the aliases Chachi used.

The couple once discovered a star with three dead planets, all of which were rich in [[Helixell]], a key [[mineral]] in hyperdrive [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]]. As of [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], they were deciding on whether to report their findings to the Empire or secretly claim the Helixell for themselves.<ref name="Screen">[[Star Wars Screen Entertainment|''Star Wars'' Screen Entertainment]]</ref>

They were also known to have smuggled [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in their [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], ''[[Millanti]]''.<ref name="POTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Chachi_and_Ohwun_De_Maal-GG7.jpg|250px|thumb|The De Maals in one of their docking bays]]
The ''Masters of the Empire'' interview with host [[Jay Laga'aia]], which took place on the Celebration Stage during [[Celebration V]] in [[August]] [[2010]], revealed that, during the cantina scene from [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']], [[Jon Berg]] played both Madak and Keeg.<ref name="MotE">{{SWArchive|url=fans/events/cv_masters_of_the_empire/index.html|text=Masters of the Empire}}</ref> They were called "Goggle-Eyes" on the set; they were not named until years later.<ref name="SWI95">{{InsiderCite|95|May The Facts Be With You: Part Two|May The Facts Be With You: Part Two: #51-100}}</ref>

In the [[Star Wars Gamer 2|''Star Wars Gamer'' 2]] article "[[The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Duros]]," Madak and his partner Keeg were both identified as the two Duros, Owhun De Maal and Chachi De Maal, from ''[[Galaxy Guide 7: Mos Eisley]]'' that owned Docking Bay 94. The information clarified that Baniss Keeg and Ellorrs Madak were aliases used by the Duros couple. This [[Retroactive continuity|retcon]] also identified Ohwun De Maal as the Duros known as Bringe that appeared in the ''[[Star Wars Screen Entertainment]]'' sourcebook.

''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]'' spelled Ellorrs Madak's first name "Ellor."

Madak was the No. 1 Fan's Choice Figure for [[Hasbro]]'s Power of the Jedi line.
